test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

“Where is your office?” Anita said to me.

options.text: Anita asked where my office were.
Anita enquired where my office was.
Anita asked where was my office?

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Anita enquired where my office was.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Reported speech is used to convey what someone said in the past.
 
• In reported speech, the tense of the verb often changes from the original sentence.
 
• When reporting a question, we use an introductory verb like "**asked**" or "**enquired**" and change the word order of the sentence.
 
• To convert the direct speech "Where is your office?" into reported speech:
 
 
• Change the reporting verb (**said**) to an appropriate verb like "**enquired**" for a question.
 
• Move the reporting verb to the past tense ("enquired").
 
• Introduce a reporting clause ("**where**") to report the question.
 
• Change the pronoun "**your**" to match the context of the reporting clause ("**my**").
 
• Change the word order to place the subject ("**my office**") before the verb ("**was**").
 
 
 
• The reported speech version is: "*Anita enquired where my office was.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
